blocks.content: Explore a finished dashboard to find its time series panels and read one value at one time.

blocks.title: Read a value at a time

blocks.content: Open **Sample Website Dashboard** in full-dashboard view.
Find the panels that draw a line across time: **Memory / CPU**, **logins**, **server requests**, and **client side full page load**. Each one answers "How has this value gone up and down over time?"
Find time on the horizontal axis and the number of requests on the vertical axis. Use the legend to tell the two series apart.
Hover over the graph. Read a timestamp and one series' value in the tooltip. Move to a later time and follow the same series. Notice whether it rises or falls.
A time series needs timestamped numeric values. A stat would reduce these samples to one number and hide the pattern.
Open **Time series graphs** and scroll to the **Styles** row.
Its three panels, **Lines**, **Points**, and **Bars**, draw the same kind of data three ways. The marks change. The timestamped values behind them don't.
You've found time series panels, read one series across time, and seen lines, points, and bars as three displays of the same kind of data.
